req.title: Player payload includes position
req.statement: The system shall include the position field on every player response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-034 requires that every player response from GET /players/{id} includes the 'position' field. I design: (1) a positive EP test verifying 'position' is present, non-null, and matches the seeded value for a known player; (2) a negative NEG test verifying that a non-existent UUID returns HTTP 404 (error pathway); (3) a BVA boundary test verifying the 'position' field value is exactly a non-empty string (not None, not empty) for a player at the boundary of the seeded dataset (squad 1 and squad 26); (4) a DT test verifying multiple players all carry 'position' in their response, catching mutations that conditionally omit the field; (5) a STC test verifying that a freshly created player also returns 'position' in its GET-by-id response, covering the state transition from creation to retrieval.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_position_field_present_and_correct

trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_position_field_present_and_correct():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'position' in body
    assert body['position'] is not None
    assert body['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert isinstance(body['position'], str)
    assert len(body['position']) > 0

tests.name: test_get_multiple_players_by_id_all_have_position
preconditions: Multiple seeded players exist with distinct positions
actions: Send GET /players/{id} for players with squad numbers 1, 10, 12, 26 using their known UUIDs
expected: All response bodies contain 'position' key with exact expected string value
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on EVERY player response — decision table covering multiple distinct position values
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_multiple_players_by_id_all_have_position():
    cases = [
        ('97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802', 'Defensive Midfield'),
        ('e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6', 'Right Winger'),
        ('a2fd538c-7747-40d5-a480-a1ecac098787', 'Goalkeeper'),
        ('77a3ac92-52d1-48c4-871c-73988df20dc8', 'Defensive Midfield'),
    ]
    for player_id, expected_position in cases:
        r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 for {player_id}, got {r.status_code}'
        body = r.json()
        assert 'position' in body, f'position missing for {player_id}'
        assert body['position'] == expected_position, (
            f'Expected position={expected_position!r} for {player_id}, got {body["position"]!r}'
        )

tests.name: test_newly_created_player_get_by_id_includes_position
preconditions: Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=27 and position='Left Winger'
Extract the returned id from the POST response
Send GET /players/{id} using the returned id
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response — state transition from created to retrieved
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_newly_created_player_get_by_id_includes_position():
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Test',
        'lastName': 'Player',
        'squadNumber': 27,
        'position': 'Left Winger',
    }
    post_r = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    created = post_r.json()
    assert 'id' in created
    player_id = created['id']
    assert created['position'] == 'Left Winger'

    get_r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    body = get_r.json()
    assert 'position' in body
    assert body['position'] == 'Left Winger'
    assert body['id'] == player_id

tests.executable:

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_invalid_uuid_format_returns_4xx():
    r = client.get('/players/not-a-valid-uuid')
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert 'position' not in body
